notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two aritfacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R/G}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
